117	## 7. Final Report
118	
119	### Delivered scope
120	O runtime hospeda `review-check`, `closeout-check`, `artifact-check`, `surface-check` e `roadmap-check` por `pose runtime run`, com resultado tipado, digest de ambiente, fallback standalone e sem repetir o que pode ter rodado (R7, R10), e guarda entre comandos as leituras puras do Git por commit (R5); o segundo `review-check` deste repositório levou cerca de 10 s contra cerca de 25 s standalone, com a mesma saída.
121	
122	### Files and modules changed
123	- pose-mcp/internal/pose (memo residente e gancho na captura), worktreeruntime (protocolo), cli (hospedagem e `run`), ajuda e os quatro POSE.md; a matriz ganha `resident-cache-integration`.

127	- Result: registrado pela evidência de validação selada; revisão delegada independente concluída com `pose review conclude`.

129	### Residual risks
130	- O digest de ambiente é uma lista: uma variável que decida uma resposta e não esteja nela faz o runtime responder com o ambiente dele.
131	- Um comando hospedado que atualiza arquivos derivados o faz com a identidade do processo do runtime, a mesma do usuário.

13	// ResidentGitMemo keeps, in a process that outlives one operation, the output of the Git reads
14	// that are pure functions of object ids or of the commit HEAD named when they ran (see
15	// governancePureGitRead). It is off unless a process turns it on, so nothing changes for a
16	// command that runs once; the optional worktree runtime turns it on (spec
17	// pose-worktree-runtime-resident-cache). A hit is the answer Git would give: the key
18	// holds the commit and the shallow state, and the output of such a read cannot differ for them.
19	type ResidentGitMemo struct {
20		mu      sync.Mutex
21		max     int64
22		bytes   int64
23		entries map[string]*list.Element
24		order   *list.List // front is the most recently used
25		hits    atomic.Int64
26		misses  atomic.Int64
27	}
28	
29	type residentGitEntry struct {
30		key    string
31		stdout []byte
32	}
33	
34	var residentGit atomic.Pointer[ResidentGitMemo]
35	
36	// EnableResidentGitMemo turns the memo on with a byte budget for what it retains.
37	func EnableResidentGitMemo(maxBytes int64) *ResidentGitMemo {
38		m := &ResidentGitMemo{max: maxBytes, entries: map[string]*list.Element{}, order: list.New()}
39		residentGit.Store(m)
40		return m
41	}
42	
43	// DisableResidentGitMemo turns the memo off and drops what it held.
44	func DisableResidentGitMemo() { residentGit.Store(nil) }
45	
46	// ResidentGitMemoStats are the hits, misses, entries and retained bytes since it was enabled.
47	func ResidentGitMemoStats() (hits, misses int64, entries int, bytes int64) {
48		m := residentGit.Load()
49		if m == nil {
50			return 0, 0, 0, 0
51		}
52		m.mu.Lock()
53		defer m.mu.Unlock()
54		return m.hits.Load(), m.misses.Load(), len(m.entries), m.bytes
55	}
56	
57	// residentGitKey names a read: the root, the commit it was made at (empty for a read by object
58	// id), the shallow state of the repository and the exact command. A root whose Git directory
59	// is not a plain .git directory is not memoized: its shallow state is not read here.
60	func residentGitKey(root, head string, args []string) (string, bool) {
61		gitDir := filepath.Join(root, ".git")
62		info, err := os.Lstat(gitDir)
63		if err != nil || !info.IsDir() {
64			return "", false
65		}
66		shallow := "-"
67		if s, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(gitDir, "shallow")); err == nil {
68			shallow = fmt.Sprintf("%d:%d", s.Size(), s.ModTime().UnixNano())
69		}
70		// The repository's own config can change what a read answers (log.follow, for one).
71		config := "-"
72		if c, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(gitDir, "config")); err == nil {
73			config = fmt.Sprintf("%d:%d", c.Size(), c.ModTime().UnixNano())
74		}
75		return strings.Join([]string{filepath.Clean(root), head, shallow, config, strings.Join(args, "\x00")}, "\x01"), true
76	}
77	
78	func (m *ResidentGitMemo) get(key string) ([]byte, bool) {
79		m.mu.Lock()
80		defer m.mu.Unlock()
81		el, ok := m.entries[key]
82		if !ok {
83			m.misses.Add(1)
84			return nil, false
85		}
86		m.order.MoveToFront(el)
87		m.hits.Add(1)
88		return append([]byte(nil), el.Value.(*residentGitEntry).stdout...), true
89	}
90	
91	func (m *ResidentGitMemo) put(key string, stdout []byte) {
92		size := int64(len(key) + len(stdout))
93		m.mu.Lock()
94		defer m.mu.Unlock()
95		if size > m.max {
96			return
97		}
98		if el, ok := m.entries[key]; ok {
99			m.bytes -= int64(len(el.Value.(*residentGitEntry).key) + len(el.Value.(*residentGitEntry).stdout))
100			m.order.Remove(el)
101			delete(m.entries, key)
102		}
103		for m.bytes+size > m.max {
104			last := m.order.Back()
105			if last == nil {
106				break
107			}
108			e := last.Value.(*residentGitEntry)
109			m.bytes -= int64(len(e.key) + len(e.stdout))
110			m.order.Remove(last)
111			delete(m.entries, e.key)
112		}
113		m.entries[key] = m.order.PushFront(&residentGitEntry{key: key, stdout: append([]byte(nil), stdout...)})
114		m.bytes += size
115	}

1	package pose
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"regexp"
6		"strings"
7	)
8	
9	// A read-view operation reruns every Git command it captured when it ends, to prove the
10	// output did not change while the operation ran. Some commands cannot change: their output is
11	// a pure function of object ids, or of the commit HEAD named when they ran. For those the
12	// rerun proves nothing the commit does not already prove, and it is the dearest part of a
13	// check (spec pose-governance-audit-skips-pure-git-reads).
14	
15	var governanceFullObjectID = regexp.MustCompile(`^[0-9a-f]{40}$`)
16	
17	// governancePureGitRead classifies a captured command. byObject means the output depends on
18	// object ids alone; byHead means it depends on the commit HEAD named when it ran, which the
19	// capture reads before and after the command. Anything not listed exactly is neither, and
20	// keeps its rerun: a ref name, --all, a pretty format that names refs, or a flag the
21	// classification does not know can all make the output depend on mutable state.
22	func governancePureGitRead(args []string) (byObject, byHead bool) {
23		if len(args) == 0 {
24			return false, false
25		}
26		switch args[0] {
27		case "show":
28			// show <40-hex>:<path>
29			if len(args) == 2 {
30				id, path, ok := strings.Cut(args[1], ":")
31				return ok && governanceFullObjectID.MatchString(id) && path != "", false
32			}
33		case "cat-file":
34			// cat-file blob <40-hex>
35			return len(args) == 3 && args[1] == "blob" && governanceFullObjectID.MatchString(args[2]), false
36		case "log":
37			// log -1 --format=%H -- <path...>: the last commit that changed the paths, from HEAD.
38			if len(args) >= 5 && args[1] == "-1" && args[2] == "--format=%H" && args[3] == "--" {
39				return false, true
40			}
41		case "ls-tree":
42			// ls-tree [flags] <40-hex> [-- <path...>]
43			i := 1
44			for i < len(args) && strings.HasPrefix(args[i], "-") && args[i] != "--" {
45				switch args[i] {
46				case "-z", "-r", "-t", "-l", "--name-only", "--full-tree":
47				default:
48					return false, false
49				}
50				i++
51			}
52			if i >= len(args) {
53				return false, false
54			}
55			tree := args[i]
56			i++
57			if i < len(args) && args[i] != "--" {
58				return false, false
59			}
60			// ls-tree HEAD is cheap to rerun and dearer to qualify (two HEAD reads): it keeps its rerun.
61			return governanceFullObjectID.MatchString(tree), false
62		}
63		return false, false
64	}
65	
66	// governanceAuditGit runs a captured command again for the final audit; tests replace it to
67	// count the reruns.
68	var governanceAuditGit = runGovernanceGitCommandOutputContext
69	
70	// governanceHeadAt reads HEAD of a root directly, outside any read view, so that no
71	// observation is recorded and the answer is the repository's now.
72	func governanceHeadAt(ctx context.Context, files Files, root string) string {
73		stdout, _, err := runGovernanceGitCommandOutputContext(ctx, files, root, []string{"rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD"}, 4096)
74		if err != nil {
75			return ""
76		}
77		return strings.TrimSpace(string(stdout))
78	}
